description: Disaster-recovery drill scenarios for scripts/drills/drill.mjs. Each scenario's `command` is the LOCAL-SAFE form (dry-run/plan mode) executed by default. `liveCommand` documents the real-drill invocation used against staging — see docs/resilience/disaster-recovery.md. `rtoTargetSeconds` is the recovery-time objective the REAL drill is measured against; in dry-run mode the elapsed time is only a lower-bound proxy.

scenarios.title: Restore database from backup into a scratch database
scenarios.description: Delegates to scripts/db/restore-test/restore-test.mjs. Dry-run validates argument parsing and prints the create -> restore -> verify -> drop plan without touching a database. A real drill restores the newest artifact in backups/ (or --file) into a throwaway scratch DB on the same server, verifies tables/row counts/migration state, then drops it.

scenarios.title: Backup pipeline plan (pg_dump -> encrypt -> prune)
scenarios.description: Delegates to scripts/db/backup/backup.ts --dry-run. Validates preflight order and prints the full backup plan (dump format, artifact path, encryption mode, retention) without producing an artifact.

scenarios.title: Roll back a deploy to the previous recorded release
scenarios.description: Delegates to scripts/deploy/rollback.mjs --dry-run. Prints the release list lookup and the merged host.env + release env compose plan without SSHing anywhere. A real drill runs the same command without --dry-run against staging with DEPLOY_HOST/DEPLOY_DIR set.

scenarios.title: Secret-store configuration check
scenarios.description: Runs scripts/secrets/check.ts in development mode: validates that every expected secret name is present and well-formed WITHOUT printing values. Missing names are tolerated outside production (pass --production to require all). Proves the injected environment a container would boot with is diagnosable during an incident.
scenarios.liveCommand: npm run secrets:check -- --production   (on the origin, inside the container env)

scenarios.title: Dual-key rotation drill (edge HMAC + B2 credential overlap)
scenarios.description: Runs scripts/secrets/rotation-drill.ts — a fully offline drill using ephemeral keys: verifies the previous key works during the overlap window, the current key signs/verifies, and revoked keys are rejected after cleanup. No secret store or provider calls.
scenarios.liveCommand: npm run secrets:verify-rotation   (against real injected env on staging)

scenarios.title: Monitoring rule evaluation (incl. backup-staleness)
scenarios.description: Runs scripts/db/monitoring/check.mjs --dry-run, which evaluates every alert rule in rules.json against demo values — including backup-staleness, the rule that detects a broken backup pipeline during a DR event — without connecting to a database.
scenarios.liveCommand: node scripts/db/monitoring/check.mjs [--only backup-staleness]   (with DATABASE_URL / MONITOR_BACKUP_DIR set)
